# format_split_path { #dyf.format_split_path }

```python
format_split_path(
    item_index,
    split_keywords,
    tree,
    leaf_batches,
    children_map,
    *,
    top_k=3,
)
```

Return the keyword path for a single item from root to leaf.

Traces which child the item belongs to at each split level and
returns the top-k keywords for that child.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name           | Type                                                                     | Description                         | Default    |
|----------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------|------------|
| item_index     | [int](`int`)                                                             | The item's index in the dataset.    | _required_ |
| split_keywords | [dict](`dict`)                                                           | Output of compute_split_keywords(). | _required_ |
| tree           | [list](`list`)\[[TreeNode](`dyf.lazy_index.TreeNode`)\]                  | Tree structure list.                | _required_ |
| leaf_batches   | [dict](`dict`)\[[int](`int`), [np](`numpy`).[ndarray](`numpy.ndarray`)\] | {node_id: item_indices}.            | _required_ |
| children_map   | [dict](`dict`)\[[int](`int`), [list](`list`)\[[int](`int`)\]\]           | {parent_id: [child_ids]}.           | _required_ |
| top_k          | [int](`int`)                                                             | Number of keywords per path step.   | `3`        |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                           | Description                                                   |
|--------|--------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [list](`list`)\[[str](`str`)\] | List of comma-separated keyword strings, one per split level. |
|        | [list](`list`)\[[str](`str`)\] | E.g.: ["screw,plate,fixation", "pedicle,cervical,spine"]      |
